response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diffed AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) FROM per_account) AS diff FROM per_account), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rnk FROM diffed) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM diffed ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10)) OR diff >= (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM diffed ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10)) ORDER BY diff DESC

assumptions.assumption: Top 10 plus ties is defined as all rows whose difference is >= the 10th-highest row's difference (row-based 10th place, not the 10th distinct value). The average is taken over accounts that have at least one order that joins to an account and district.
